notes.title: Announcement on our Steam page
notes.content:
Hello everyone, during this time:

[list]
[*] We've upgraded our Steam page: images, GIFs, trailer iteration 2, screenshots.
[*] We've created pages on itch and jotl where builds will be published. We'll share them soon.
[*] Spectator mode implemented. Now you can follow the opponent who killed you to ensure it's not a cheater.
[*] Fixing bugs and addressing errors.
[/list]

Stay tuned with us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/z8JfwqEESx

notes.title: Update, update, update...
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm waiting in line at the doctor's, so let's get straight to the point:

[list]
[*] We've updated the translation of the page into Turkish.

[*] Improved and trained the Artificial Intelligence of enemies.

[*] Added additional locations for the game.
[/list]

Thanks for your attention, I'm off to my appointment.

notes.title: Two-week sprint update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, welcome back to our bi-weekly news segment.

During this time, we:

[list]
[*] Translated the page into Chinese, Italian, and French.

[*] Fixed bugs and tackled other issues to enhance and improve the game's quality.

[*] Integrated a couple of hand animations in various positions from the first person perspective.

[*] Expanded the arsenal of weapons.

[*] Enhanced the artificial intelligence of enemies. Now there's an opponent who actively picks up and throws items at you, even if it's just a rock or a pebble.
P.S Yes, it works a bit differently than just spear throwing.
[/list]

Looks like that's all for now, catch you later.
